أتضاعف (form VI)
# أَتَضَاعَفُ (ʔataḍāʕafu) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.ʕa.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَضَاعَفَ (taḍāʕafa)
# أَتَضَاعَفَ (ʔataḍāʕafa) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.ʕa.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَضَاعَفَ (taḍāʕafa)
# أَتَضَاعَفْ (ʔataḍāʕaf) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.ʕaf/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَضَاعَفَ (taḍāʕafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
